answer: An admission auction blocks fake identities. Each epoch offers 200 slots: applicants bid, and only the top 200 pay the clearing price, locked for 20 epochs. A sparrow trying to forge a flock must win for every fake, so 1,000 fakes at 500 coins each cost 500,000 coins, while each earns only one slot's share. At dawn, an honest agent pays once, recovers its bid in 6 epochs from undiluted rewards; a forger earns nothing extra.
